title: The Trial of the Veteran
text: A hooded thing stands in the road with a sword across its knees. It wants the one among you who has seen the most, and it will not take anyone else.

options.label: The most travelled faces it alone.

outcomes.text: Steel on steel, a long time, and then the hooded thing steps aside and bows.
It is better than anyone they have fought. It lets them live, and they will carry the lesson.
